title: Grilled Argentine-Style Steak with Chimichurri
description: A classic Argentine dish featuring a grilled steak served with a tangy and herby chimichurri sauce.

ingredients.name: Ribeye Steaks
ingredients.notes: Choose high-quality, grass-fed steaks for optimal flavor

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: High-quality, such as Argentine extra virgin olive oil

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Coarse, such as fleur de sel

instructions: 1. In a blender or food processor, combine parsley, oregano, garlic, red pepper flakes, red wine vinegar, and olive oil.
2. Blend until smooth, then season with salt and black pepper.
3. Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
4. Season the steaks with salt, black pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil.
5. Grill the steaks for 3-4 minutes per side, or until they reach your desired level of doneness.
6. Transfer the steaks to a cutting board and let them rest for 5-10 minutes.
7. Slice the steaks against the grain and serve with chimichurri sauce spooned over the top.
